message.content: {"caption":"A three-part schematic showing how an agent collects reusable experiences, uses them during rollouts, and incorporates selected experience into policy training.","description":"A left-to-right diagram with three numbered panels. ① “Experience Acquisition”: A robot with three small thought bubbles sends an arrow labeled “experiences” toward a second robot, shown with small note-like symbols above it. Below, a two-headed vertical arrow links this area to a green bar reading “recall ⊕ rerank ⊕ rewrite.” A dashed horizontal divider separates it from an “Experience Pool,” depicted with a database-and-gear icon and three connected example entries: “When exporting data to a file…,” “When interacting with APIs…,” and “When needing to retrieve…”. ② “Experience-mixed Rollout”: A vertical lavender box labeled “query” feeds rightward branching arrows to six rollout rows, grouped under “Experience-free Rollouts” (three rows) and “Experience-guided Rollouts” (three rows), each with a small robot icon. The free rows show, in sequence, null → trajectory → A<0 with a red unhappy face and red X; null → trajectory → A>0 with a green smiling face and green check; and null → trajectory → A<0 with a red unhappy face and red X. The guided rows show exp → trajectory → A>0 with a green smiling face and check; exp → trajectory → A>0 with a green smiling face and check; and exp → trajectory → A<0 with a red unhappy face and X. ③ “Experience Incorporation”: In “Experience Stripping,” a lavender query block sits beside a hatched column listing null, null, exp, and exp. Four corresponding rows show trajectory followed by A<0, A>0, A>0, and A>0; the first two entries in the hatched column are crossed by diagonal hatching, and smiling-face markers appear beside the two lower A>0 rows. An ellipsis indicates more rows, and a bracket groups the row list on the right. In the lower “Experience Incorporation” area, stacked cards labeled “Training Samples” lead to the condition “If exp & A>0,” then a right-pointing arrow leads to a “Policy Model” box containing a robot icon. Beneath the condition is a smiling-face symbol and the instruction “clip higher!”; a flame symbol appears above the policy-model box.","figure_type":"diagram","chart_values":[]}
